why: Records at taught levels that no lesson unlocks, each with the reason the gap is known and held rather than a silent regression. validate_unlock_ledger treats a taught-level record as a FAILURE unless it is unlocked exactly once or listed here; an entry matching nothing is also a failure, so this list cannot rot. W11a (owner decision A6) resolved five of the nine homograph placements into real unlocks; the four that remain are deferred with a stated reason and are re-asserted on every run by validate_repairs_applied.py against research/derived/repairs/homograph_rulings.json.

vocab.reason: Homograph sibling of vocab:1247250 (君/きみ). W11a (owner decision A6) settled the disambiguation queue and DEFERRED this placement: the record deserves teaching, but where the さん / 様 / くん / ちゃん ladder lives is a curriculum choice and the card needs a line of new pt-BR prose. Candidate lesson and full evidence: research/derived/repairs/homograph_rulings.json.

Homograph sibling of vocab:1545790 (様/さま). W11a DEFERRED this one: さま is correctly taught at les:n4-suposicao-03 as the source of のよう, and whether よう also needs a card of its own depends on a policy nobody has stated — does every grammar-bearing formal noun get one, or only the ones met standalone? The answer has to cover こと, もの and ところ too. Evidence: research/derived/repairs/homograph_rulings.json.

Homograph sibling of vocab:1468060 (年/とし). W11a DEFERRED the placement, not the teaching: ねん must be taught (23 bank tokens by reading against 11, and it is the year counter), but the better home — les:n5-numeros-tempo-05, which teaches the calendar — needs a line of new prose, and とし's own unlock has no prose anywhere. Evidence: research/derived/repairs/homograph_rulings.json.

Homograph sibling of vocab:1472650 (背/せい). W11a DEFERRED it because the honest fix is probably the other one: all 9 bank tokens on the TAUGHT せい record actually read せ, so repointing the 'altura, estatura' card at les:n5-numeros-tempo-03 to this record would close the gap and fix the registry/tokenizer mismatch at once. Card-design call. Evidence: research/derived/repairs/homograph_rulings.json.
